relations.evidence: The cbimport command also supports custom key-generation for each document in the imported file. Key generation is done with a combination of pre-existing fields in a document and custom generator functions supplied by cbimport.

notable_absence.finding: 'Note that only the sample format can create buckets so providing this flag when using the list or lines format will exit with an error' (re: --eviction-policy) is a hard, stated restriction tying bucket-creation ability to exactly one of the three dataset-format choices, but the page gives no named mechanism for WHY sample format alone can create buckets (no reference to bucket-creation privileges or to the Couchbase Samples catalog it draws from). No relation minted to avoid inventing that reason; recorded as a finding instead.

cross_component_finding: Together with cbexport-json.json and cbimport-csv.json earlier in this batch, this page completes a three-way check for the exact self-fork risk the round's context file called out by name ('a common file format, a common flag'): the LINES/LIST dataset-format pair and the key-generator/scope-collection-expression mechanisms are each documented independently on two-to-three pages within this single batch, in near-identical wording. All were minted once and reused thereafter rather than re-minted per page.
